استخرن (form X)
# اِسْتَخَرْنَ (istaḵarna) /is.ta.xar.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَخَارَ (istaḵāra)
# اُسْتُخِرْنَ (ustuḵirna) /us.tu.xir.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَخَارَ (istaḵāra)
# اِسْتَخِرْنَ (istaḵirna) /is.ta.xir.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَخَارَ (istaḵāra)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
